Everything above about "50X Merry MONEY" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1917.headline: Tickets sold so far

1918.body:
"100X Merry MONEY" is near the start of its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "100X Merry MONEY", with every prize level included.
1918.headline: Where this game is in its run

1921.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES", about two-thirds are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
